items.source: Uses of RequestExpectation in org.springframework.test.web.client
items.translation: `org.springframework.test.web.client` 包中 `RequestExpectation` 的用法

items.source: Default implementation of RequestExpectation that simply delegates to the request matchers and the response creator it contains.
items.translation: RequestExpectation 的默认实现，它简单地委托给其包含的请求匹配器和响应创建器。

items.source: Return a matching expectation, or null if none match.
items.translation: 返回匹配的期望，如果没有匹配则返回null。

items.source: As of 5.0.3 subclasses should implement this method instead of #validateRequestInternal(ClientHttpRequest) in order to match the request to an expectation, leaving the call to create the response as a separate step (to be invoked by this class).
items.translation: 自 5.0.3 版本起，子类应实现此方法以替代#validateRequestInternal(ClientHttpRequest)来匹配请求预期，而将创建响应的调用作为单独步骤保留（由本类调用）。
包含客户端 REST 测试支持。

items.source: Return a read-only list of the expectations.
Invoke this for an expectation that has been matched.
items.translation: 为此已匹配的期望调用此方法。
